title: Small populations drift more
hook: Two stated cases: explore the conditional one-generation Wright-Fisher spread.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the conditional one-generation Wright-Fisher spread affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines SD, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the conditional one-generation Wright-Fisher spread in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
